name: Add Emoji Reaction
description: Add an emoji reaction to a message. [See the documentation](https://api.slack.com/methods/reactions.add)

configurable_props.name: conversation
configurable_props.label: Channel
configurable_props.description: Channel where the message to add reaction to was posted.

configurable_props.name: timestamp
configurable_props.label: Message Timestamp
configurable_props.description: Timestamp of the message to add reaction to. e.g. `1403051575.000407`.

configurable_props.name: icon_emoji
configurable_props.label: Icon (emoji)
configurable_props.description: Provide an emoji to use as the icon for this reaction. E.g. `fire`
